# Leaflet 1.9.4

Draws the Route tab's Map on OpenStreetMap streets (owner's decision 2026-10-28; `js/app/route.js`).
The map pictures come from tile.openstreetmap.org (OpenStreetMap's own servers, free, no account;
their tile policy says commercial use may be blocked at any time, in which case the stops and lines
still show on a plain background). Without a connection there are no streets, only the stops.

- Source: npm package `leaflet` 1.9.4, https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz
  (sha1 23fae724e282fa25745aff82ca4d394748db7d8d, matches the registry), downloaded 2026-10-28.
  Files unchanged, from `dist`. The default marker images are not used (the stops are drawn as
  numbered dots), so `dist/images` is left out.
